note: The crawler's published identity, for bot-verification programmes and for anyone who wants to confirm that traffic claiming to be TallyhouseIndexBot is ours. The user-agent string is NOT stored here: it lives in src/tallyhouse/constants.py, which is what the collector actually sends, and a second copy here could drift from it.
purpose: Fetches only /robots.txt, once a week, from a fixed published panel of domains, to measure how many sites disallow AI crawlers. Does not request any other path, follow links, execute JavaScript, or collect page content.

prefixes.note: Single dedicated host. All TallyhouseIndexBot requests originate here.
